# dsh-github-router > 提供PR、Issue、文件及API只读工具，通过API、gh、Git、HTML与可选镜像在宿主内降级取数。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[AngelosZou/dsh-github-router](https://github.com/AngelosZou/dsh-github-router) - **版本号**：0.4.1（[固定提交 b5c056e1b50fb3446a153bae7ecf2d923f6f7923](https://github.com/AngelosZou/dsh-github-router/tree/b5c056e1b50fb3446a153bae7ecf2d923f6f7923)） - **版本日期**：2026-09-29（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 核心贡献 将多传输故障处理和PR逐部分取数封装为Agent读取流程，减少shell重试与人工拼接。详见[Q01](#research-q01)。 ## 关键质疑 URL缓存不绑定凭据主体，本地路径以origin匹配替代授权闭合；分页、HTML候选与镜像也限制完整性。详见[Q04](#research-q04)。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 可研究身份分区缓存与对象/SHA/分页/截断来源清单，按换身份和错对象反例比较错误复用。当前未验证。详见[Q07](#research-q07)。 进一步从身份切换同URL、百文件分页、多JSON候选、镜像内容和不同ref并发探讨来源快照契约。 ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标：**固定版本多路由GitHub读取的贡献、身份授权、内容完整性与采用条件是什么？ ### Q01 · 为什么在宿主提供GitHub只读路由？ **研究主题：**场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 面向Agent在沙箱里因TLS/代理失败反复尝试shell命令、又需要读取PR、Issue与源码的开发者。合格结果应给请求对象的正文、代码及讨论，标注实际来源、截断和失败部分；不能把多路由返回内容等同同一时间完整仓库快照。README的价值主张是把网络故障重试收进工具内部，而非要求Agent自行升级权限。 简单替代是已有GitHub连接器、配置好的gh/API或人工提供固定源码。插件贡献是宿主多传输路线、按PR部分降级与结构化输出的组合，不是新GitHub协议或网络突破技术。gh/git/HTML各路线具备的信息不相同，route attribution比统一“成功”更有实际意义。README的无依赖与离线安装指没有新增运行时包，manifest仍列宿主peer依赖，不能理解为无宿主和无网络也能在线读GitHub。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:5-19](https://github.com/AngelosZou/dsh-github-router/blob/b5c056e1b50fb3446a153bae7ecf2d923f6f7923/README.md#L5-L19) 作者提出五工具、多路由及上下文效率。
查看原文（15行） ```text > Read-only GitHub access for a DeepSeek Harness project — load PRs, issues, files, and API data through tools that route internally (API, gh CLI, git protocol, page HTML, mirrors), so an agent never burns turns fighting shell-side TLS or proxy failures. [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Node.js >= 22.19](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-%3E%3D22.19-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org/) [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-github-router)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-github-router) A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin bundle that gives agents GitHub reads without shell retries: - **Five read-only tools** — `github_probe`, `github_pr`, `github_issue`, `github_file`, `github_api` — plus the `github-router` skill and a system-prompt guidance section. No write, push, comment, or mutation capability exists anywhere in the package. - **In-tool routing** — every request runs host-side (outside the sandbox's TLS/proxy restrictions) and falls through a route ladder: `api.github.com` (direct → proxy) → `gh` CLI (read-only subcommands) → git protocol (plugin fetch cache, or a local clone read with log/diff/show only) → PR/issue page HTML (strict JSON island extraction) → user-configured raw mirrors. - **One call, structured outcome** — PRs come back with metadata, discussion, reviews, commits, changed files, and the diff, each part annotated with the route that served it; failures return a route matrix instead of a dozen retried shell commands. - **Connectivity probe** — `github_probe` reports which routes are live from the host in one call, with timings and a recommended route chain. - **Zero runtime dependencies** — peers resolve from the DSH profile; proxied requests travel through the plugin's own CONNECT tunnel (no third-party HTTP stack), so the package installs fully offline. - **Framework-declared settings page** — the plugin exports its `Config` schema, so DSH serves the `dsh-github-router` namespace to the browser and opening the plugin on **Plugins** page shows the page (secret token, proxy, route switches, cache TTLs, byte caps) with staged edits, override badges, and a write-only token control. - **Context efficiency** — response caching with per-kind TTLs, byte caps everywhere, list caps with truncation notes, and rate-limit surfacing. ```

A successfully fetched empty // list is authoritative and must NOT trigger a fallback ladder — the // routes are failover, not fan-out (docs/design.md). fetched: { meta: false, discussion: false, reviews: false, commits: false, files: false, diff: false }, ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[package.json:67-71](https://github.com/AngelosZou/dsh-github-router/blob/b5c056e1b50fb3446a153bae7ecf2d923f6f7923/package.json#L67-L71) 宿主peer依赖。 ```text "peerDependencies": { "@deepseek-ai/cordis": "^4.0.4", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-credentials": "^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.0-rc.1", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools": "^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.0-rc.1", "@deepseek-ai/schemastery": "^3.18.4" ``` ### Q02 · 从工具调用到不同读取路线如何衔接？ **研究主题：**功能与机制 #### 完整回答 入口装配动态settings options、一个Skill、guidance和五工具。buildRuntime每次构建API客户端、默认TTL磁盘缓存、凭据解析以及subprocess；token优先配置文字，再凭据服务，再进程环境，解析只在当次runtime按tokenEnv记忆。HTTP路线按direct/proxy阶梯尝试，ABORTED在这层立即抛出，其他失败保留为ROUTE_FAILED。 PR先API取元信息，再并行取所需列表/差异，并记录每部分来源，已成功得到的空列表不继续扇出。文件路线不同，为API contents、raw、可选mirror、最后Git，API文件返回blob SHA，raw/Git结果可仍用分支名ref。文件的raw请求不被routesApi关闭，并没有单独raw关闭项；github_api也直接调用API阶梯，不读取routes.api开关。开关应理解为部分聚合策略，不能当全局网络禁止策略。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[lib/index.js:46-58](https://github.com/AngelosZou/dsh-github-router/blob/b5c056e1b50fb3446a153bae7ecf2d923f6f7923/lib/index.js#L46-L58) 入口注册面。

      "path": "README.md",
      "content": "# dsh-github-router\n\n**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)\n\n> Read-only GitHub access for a DeepSeek Harness project — load PRs, issues, files, and API data through tools that route internally (API, gh CLI, git protocol, page HTML, mirrors), so an agent never burns turns fighting shell-side TLS or proxy failures.\n\n[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)\n[![Node.js >= 22.19](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-%3E%3D22.19-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org/)\n[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-github-router)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-github-router)\n\nA [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin bundle that gives agents GitHub reads without shell retries:\n\n- **Five read-only tools** — `github_probe`, `github_pr`, `github_issue`, `github_file`, `github_api` — plus the `github-router` skill and a system-prompt guidance section. No write, push, comment, or mutation capability exists anywhere in the package.\n- **In-tool routing** — every request runs host-side (outside the sandbox's TLS/proxy restrictions) and falls through a route ladder: `api.github.com` (direct → proxy) → `gh` CLI (read-only subcommands) → git protocol (plugin fetch cache, or a local clone read with log/diff/show only) → PR/issue page HTML (strict JSON island extraction) → user-configured raw mirrors.\n- **One call, structured outcome** — PRs come back with metadata, discussion, reviews, commits, changed files, and the diff, each part annotated with the route that served it; failures return a route matrix instead of a dozen retried shell commands.\n- **Connectivity probe** — `github_probe` reports which routes are live from the host in one call, with timings and a recommended route chain.\n- **Zero runtime dependencies** — peers resolve from the DSH profile; proxied requests travel through the plugin's own CONNECT tunnel (no third-party HTTP stack), so the package installs fully offline.\n- **Framework-declared settings page** — the plugin exports its `Config` schema, so DSH serves the `dsh-github-router` namespace to the browser and opening the plugin on **Plugins** page shows the page (secret token, proxy, route switches, cache TTLs, byte caps) with staged edits, override badges, and a write-only token control.\n- **Context efficiency** — response caching with per-kind TTLs, byte caps everywhere, list caps with truncation notes, and rate-limit surfacing.\n\n## Requirements\n\n- Node.js >= 22.19\n- Optional: the `gh` CLI (authenticated) for the gh route; `git` for the git route\n\n## Install\n\nFrom npm:\n\n```bash\ndsh plugin --profile web add dsh-github-router\n```\n\nFrom a local checkout (development):\n\n```bash\ndsh plugin --profile web add link:<absolute-path-to-this-repo>\n```\n\nFrom a git host:\n\n```bash\ndsh plugin --profile web add github:<owner>/dsh-github-router\n```\n\nThen **restart the DSH backend** — the host composition loads at process start. The tools appear in new sessions: `github_probe`, `github_pr`, `github_issue`, `github_file`, `github_api`, plus the `github-router` skill.\n\n## Compatibility\n\nThis plugin tracks the DSH plugin API, which does not keep backward\ncompatibility between releases. Pick the plugin version that matches your\nDeepSeek Harness release:\n\n| DeepSeek Harness | Install |\n|------------------| --- |\n| 0.1.7-rc.2       | `dsh-github-router@0.4.0` or later |\n| 0.1.2 ~ 0.1.6    | `dsh-github-router@0.3.2` |\n| 0.1.1 or earlier | `dsh-github-router@0.2.1` |\n\nThe mapping is recorded in `package.json` under `dsh.compatibility.dshReleases`.\n\n## Usage\n\nAgent side:\n\n| Tool | What it does |\n| ---- | ------------ |\n| `github_probe` | One-shot connectivity matrix (api direct/proxy, gh installed/authed, git ls-remote, page direct/proxy, mirrors, token presence) with timings and a recommended route chain. Call first when access fails or is slow. |\n| `github_pr` | Full PR view: metadata, description, discussion (issue + inline review comments), reviews, commits, changed files, and the unified diff, each with route attribution. Parts toggle (`includeDiscussion`/`includeReviews`/`includeCommits`/`includeFiles`/`includeDiff`) and cap (`maxDiffBytes`/`maxItems`). `localRepo` (or session-cwd auto-detection) reads commits/diff from a local clone with zero network. |\n| `github_issue` | Issue metadata, body, labels, and comments, with route attribution. |\n| `github_file` | File content (or directory listing) at a branch/tag/sha via api contents → raw → mirrors → git; returns size, truncation state, and the serving route. |\n| `github_api` | Validated **GET-only** escape hatch for any `api.github.com` endpoint; query values sanitized, responses cached, rate-limit headers surfaced, errors carry stable codes. |\n\n```text\ngithub_probe                                                  # which routes are live right now\ngithub_pr { owner: \"o\", repo: \"r\", number: 12 }               # full PR view\ngithub_pr { owner: \"o\", repo: \"r\", number: 12, localRepo: \"C:/src/r\" }  # commits/diff from a local clone\ngithub_issue { owner: \"o\", repo: \"r\", number: 34 }\ngithub_file { owner: \"o\", repo: \"r\", path: \"src/index.js\", ref: \"main\" }\ngithub_api { path: \"/repos/o/r/commits\", query: { per_page: 5 } }\n```\n\nBehavior notes:\n\n- Route order is fixed per part type: API first (direct then proxy), then gh, then page HTML (proxy-first — machines with reset direct TLS usually reach pages through the proxy), then git, then mirrors. Each part records the route that served it.\n- Anonymous API use is rate-limited (60 requests/hour per IP); configure a token (Settings or `GITHUB_TOKEN`) for 5000/hour. Responses are cached to save quota; `forceRefresh` bypasses the cache.\n- Mirrors are **off by default** — they are third parties that see requested paths; enable them in settings only if you accept that.\n- The git route never writes to user repositories: local clones are read with `git log`/`diff`/`show` only, and fetches happen exclusively in the plugin-owned cache under `<DSH_HOME>/storages/dsh-github-router/`.\n\n## Configuration\n\nSidebar **Plugins** page → the **dsh-github-router** bundle: opening it renders\nthe plugin's configuration section directly on its page, between the\ndescription and *Parts*; the row's **Configure** control opens the same form\nagain. The framework owns the frame:\nit reads the schema this plugin exports, serves the `dsh-github-router`\nnamespace to the browser, and renders the save control. Fields the user\noverrode are badged with a reset control, and clearing a field falls back to\nthe defaults below. The token is a write-only field: a blank draft keeps the\nstored token, and the **Clear stored token** control stages the removal. The\nsame values can be set in the composition (profile `cordis.patch.yml`) as the\nplugin's base config; the page overrides per user, and a saved value applies to\nthe next tool call.\n\n| Field | Default | Meaning |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| `token` | — | Literal GitHub token (secret; redacted on the wire, write-only input). Prefer `tokenEnv`. |\n| `tokenEnv` | `GITHUB_TOKEN` | Environment variable / credential ref naming the token. |\n| `proxy` | `''` | Proxy URL for proxy attempts. `''` inherits ambient `HTTP(S)_PROXY`; `direct` never proxies. |\n| `directTimeoutMs` / `proxyTimeoutMs` | 8000 / 15000 | Per-attempt timeouts. |\n| `retries` | 1 | Retries for idempotent GETs on 429/5xx (honors `Retry-After`). |\n| `routesApi` / `routesGh` / `routesGit` / `routesHtml` / `routesMirror` | on / on / on / on / **off** | Route switches (the card shows them as checkboxes). |\n| `mirrors` | `[]` | Raw-content mirror bases, e.g. `[\"https://ghproxy.net\"]`. |\n| `cacheTtlMeta` / `cacheTtlContent` | 300 / 86400 | Response cache TTLs (PR/issue metadata vs immutable-ish content), in seconds. |\n| `maxBytes` | 1048576 | Byte cap for every response body read by the plugin. |\n| `repos` | `[]` | Local repositories granted for read-only git-route reads. |\n| `gitCacheDir` | `''` | Plugin fetch-cache dir; `''` = `<DSH_HOME>/storages/dsh-github-router/git`. |\n\n## How it works\n\n- **Host-side execution** — plugin code runs in the host process, so the sandbox's TLS credential resets and proxy misrouting never apply. The unrestricted token is compensated by the confinement model in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) — not by weakening the sandbox.\n- **Explicit proxy decisions** — global `fetch` does not inherit ambient proxy env; each attempt gets an explicit direct/proxy choice, and proxied requests use a zero-dependency CONNECT tunnel (`node:http`/`node:tls`) with target-hostname TLS validation and `accept-encoding: identity`.\n- **Strict parsing** — the page-HTML route extracts only `react-app.embeddedData` JSON islands and runs `JSON.parse` (never evaluated); a bounded BFS copies a whitelist of fields, so CSRF tokens and the raw payload never reach the model.\n- **Argv-only subprocesses** — every `gh`/`git` invocation is an argv array with fixed flag lists; user input reaches argv only after regex validation, and nothing is shell-interpolated.\n- **Tool contract** — canonical values are lossless JSON (arrays carry no side properties), byte-capped, and rendered as compact text with route attribution.\n- **Skill & guidance** — the `github-router` skill teaches tool-first usage and the \"never escalate for GitHub reads\" rule; one system-prompt section (`dsh-github-router:guidance`, order 118) reminds every session that the github_* tools are the sanctioned path.\n\n## Project layout\n\n| Path | Purpose |\n| ---- | ------- |\n| `cordis.patch.yml` | Profile patch layer inserting the `dsh-github-router` row |\n| `lib/index.js` | Host plugin: the `Config` schema export, five tools, skill, guidance |\n| `lib/client.js` | Browser half: the row configuration page (hand-written factory bundle, no build step) |\n| `lib/config.js` | Settings schema, defaults, live section reads, runtime option resolution |\n| `lib/settings.js` | Host settings wiring: the plugin-owned page policy and the options thunk |\n| `lib/net.js`, `lib/tunnel.js` | Route-aware HTTP layer;
